components.name: Burgundy cone roof strip
components.function: Need irregular stone/fort-wall returns, cylindrical tower-wall window bands, cone roof seats, stair-to-terrace corners and climbing-rose attachment layout. components.construction: One hollow conical quarter-shell with burgundy shingle pattern, 0.12 m nominal shell thickness and matching radial seam edges. Four copies rotated by 90 degrees give a 12.4 m diameter cap over S01's 12 m diameter, with 0.2 m overhang per side. Conical roof, not an onion dome. Finial and eave cornice are separate later fittings.
